successful_api_domain.alignment: all three data pointers naturally aligned to their element widths; address_aligned derives every source offset alignment
successful_api_domain.device: MemoryPrimitives.launchDevice equals each view device, each Tensor.deviceIndex equals its view device, all devices equal
successful_api_domain.extent: all active bytes within backing allocation; 64-bit storage ends and rounded-tail pointer arithmetic bounded, even for inactive lanes
successful_api_domain.inputs: both input views may overlap, coincide, or use different widths; fresh output is separate and input state has no concurrent external mutation
successful_api_domain.values: TypedHost.ValueDomain gives valid finite input storage representations plus active defined conversions; shared floating callbacks remain exactly registered numerical correspondences
successful_api_domain.scheduling: all complete active-lane lists have identical source output; physical source batches load both tiles before storing; no scheduler implementation theorem required
